text: Sports science is an interdisciplinary subject that studies the laws of human movement, the improvement of athletic ability, and the relationship between exercise and health. It integrates fields such as biology, medicine, physics, and psychology, and is dedicated to addressing issues such as "how to optimize athletic performance", "How does exercise affect health", and "how to prevent and recover from sports injuries". Its core goals include: revealing the mechanism of action of exercise on the human body system, formulating scientific training plans, promoting public health management, and advancing the development of sports rehabilitation technology.
